## What's new
- **Custom app icon.** Put an icon named `hdpt.ico` in the `Resources` folder next to `HelpDeskProTools.exe` and every window and the taskbar use it. You can swap it at any time without a new build; restart the app to pick it up. If the file is missing or isn't a valid `.ico`, the app keeps its built-in icon.

## Upgrading from v5.1.3
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.
- To use your own icon, add `Resources\hdpt.ico` next to the exe.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.1.4-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.

## Requirements
- Windows 10/11 x64, domain-joined
- RSAT Active Directory tools (for AD Console)
- PowerShell 7 recommended for Remote PS and SFC Scan (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is used as a fallback)
- Target PCs: WinRM, the `c$` admin share and WMI/RPC reachable; `AllowRemoteRPC = 1` for Send Message
